description: Ministry of Ports & Shipping - Powers & Functions of the State Minister of Ports Development Affairs
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Hon. Kanaka Herath) and provides detailed portfolio responsibilities and functions (monitoring and fulfilling specific functions related to port development, including development and management of commercial harbours, harbour-related tourism activities, and ports-related revenue generation). It contains both the "who" (government person) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities/portfolios), making it a Hybrid Gazette according to the classification rules.
